title: Discover the real problem, price it fairly, win the next client

say: Discover the real problem, price it fairly, and win the next client.

say: Read about the client first, write three hypotheses, and send a short agenda. Make sure the decision maker joins, at least for the last 10 minutes.

say: Always put a number on the problem before you price your work.
420 pupils at an average of 350,000 naira per term is 147,000,000 naira.
18% is still unpaid at the end of term. That is 26,460,000 naira.
A well-run school she admires keeps unpaid fees at about 5%, which would be 7,350,000.
The gap is 19,110,000 naira per term, plus two teachers who resigned over late salaries. Now both sides know what the problem is worth.
Ngozi needs 24,000,000 naira a year, including business costs. She expects only about 120 billable days, after selling, admin and holidays. So her day rate is 200,000 naira.

panel.heading: Build the fee from both sides
items: Day rate = income need plus costs ÷ billable days
Fee = workplan days × day rate, plus risk
Check it against the value of the result
Agree payment milestones in writing

say: Her workplan for the school is 18 days, 3,600,000 naira. With 10% for risk, she rounds to 4,000,000.

say: Your letter names the scope and, just as important, what is excluded. It lists deliverables, what the client must provide, fees and milestones, how extra work is priced, and how client information is stored and deleted.
For large or government contracts, ask a lawyer to review the terms.

panel.heading: What the letter must cover
items: Scope: what is included and excluded
Deliverables with due dates
Client responsibilities
Fees, milestones, late payment
Change requests and confidentiality

say: Ngozi writes a one-page case study: context, challenge, approach, measured results, and lessons. The proprietor agrees in writing that the school can be described but not named.

panel.heading: An honest before and after

say: Unpaid fees fell to 7%, an improvement of about 16,170,000 naira. She also says the 5% target was not yet reached. That honesty makes it more believable.
Declare any conflict of interest, and keep client information confidential after the job ends.

say: Start with the number of clients you want, for example 2.

items: Goal: 2 signed clients

12 discovery meetings, if 1 in 2 leads on
60 outreach conversations, about 5 a week
